name: Product Requirements Document
description: A PRD or feature spec for internal product or engineering teams

required_sections.title: Title & Metadata
required_sections.description: Feature name, author, date, status (draft/review/approved), version

required_sections.title: Overview
required_sections.description: 1–2 paragraph summary of the feature and why it's being built

required_sections.title: Problem Statement
required_sections.description: What problem are we solving? Who is affected?

required_sections.title: Goals & Non-Goals
required_sections.description: What this feature will and will not do

required_sections.title: Users & Use Cases
required_sections.description: Who uses this feature and how (user stories or scenarios)

required_sections.title: Design & UX Notes
required_sections.description: Links to mockups or key UX decisions

required_sections.title: Success Metrics
required_sections.description: How will we know this feature succeeded?

optional_sections.title: Technical Notes
optional_sections.description: Architecture or implementation guidance from engineering
